candidates.change_summary: Remove the state update `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so ownership never changes during transferFrom.
Assign `_ownerOf[id] = from;` instead of `to`, leaving ownership with the original holder after transferFrom.
Replace `delete getApproved[id];` with `delete _ownerOf[id];`, wiping the ownership record instead of the approval after transfer.
Insert `_ownerOf[id] = msg.sender;` after the transfer update so the caller becomes the owner of every transferred token.
